name: Klinovec Landing
notes:
1020 meters above sea
It is most practical to land close to the bottom station of the lift so you can use the lift. It is currently possible to land on geen fields close to the public parking place

name: Javorovy Landing
notes: landing field is very big and smooth, but be aware of the high tension power lines on the mountain side. They are high and almost invisible from above. Never end up too low on the mountain side. if you are too low consider emergency landing on some inclined field rather than trying to make it over the lines with a little margin.
